<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def objs(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        d[n['color']]=d.get(n['color'],[])+[(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])]
    return d
# Probe SPACE
r=action(['SPACE'], intent='explore')
print('SPACE result no_impact:', r.get('no_impact'), 'board_changed:', r.get('board_changed'))
print('BEFORE'); [print(k,v) for k,v in objs(last_transition.before_frame).items()]
print('AFTER'); [print(k,v) for k,v in objs(last_transition.after_frame).items()]
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
